run_f_gold: run f_gold to check if a square root of n exists under modulo p using brute force
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled with parameter sets to validate correctness of the transcoder implementation
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function that checks modular square root existence by iterating x from 2 to p
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use Euler criterion with modular exponentiation instead of brute force iteration
review_f_gold: review f_gold for edge cases where n mod p equals zero or p is not prime
